services.name: Booze Cruise
services.desc: Choose between our two unforgettable types of experiences: The shorter Booze Cruises are perfect for those looking to party on the water while enjoying a scenic tour of St. Pete with drinks in hand. Meanwhile, the longer Sandbar Party offers the ultimate party vibe with plenty of time to swim, relax, and soak up the sun on the sandbar. No matter your choice, fun is guaranteed! Get ready for the ultimate party on the water with our 4-hour Sandbar Party! Booze Cruise to Johns Pass Sandbar for 2+ hours of music, floats, food boats, and non-stop fun-perfect for the bach and birthday parties looking to vibe and party on the water! Hop aboard our 2.5-hour Booze Cruise and get ready for a wild

blurb: Guests board a 50' custom built catamaran named Escape for various cruises including dolphin watching, shelling adventures, island sunset tours, and skyway light shows. The boat features luxury amenities such as a beer and wine bar, satellite TV, Bluetooth sound system, fresh water showers, and restrooms. Captains with over 20 years of local experience navigate to secluded islands and local dolphin hangouts.

quotes.author: Brittney S
quotes.text: Great experience I initially almost was not allowed on the cruise, since their system did not reflect that I changed the date of my cruise a week earlier. It was not a great first impression. They were able to get me and my child on after everyone else arrived. Once we left port it was a great experience! We really enjoyed ourselves. I would do it again.

quotes.author: Michael C
quotes.text: Awesome and telaxing Had an awesome time. Very relaxing. The crew of Barry, Toby and Tony were very receptive to our needs and made us feel welcomed. Would highly recommend this cruise!

quotes.author: Maria H
quotes.text: Great sunset views Beautiful sunset, great music, amazing views of bridge!! Very relaxing and a wonderful close to the week and happy to share with friends. We will be back!

quotes.author: Alexandria S
quotes.text: Awesome Cruise! Such a wonderful time! Our captains were so personable and fun, they played great music, and we saw an awesome sunset! Highly recommend!

quotes.author: Frank D
quotes.text: Will return Captain Tim and Captain Paul were so good with my 5 yr old granddaughter. Would recommend this , money well spent for great memories.

quotes.author: Annette B
quotes.text: Relaxing This was a beautiful relaxing experience! We went out and stopped at a little island where you could walk the beach and take a sunset photo. Just beautiful over the ocean. Pelicans and other wildlife were cruising the waters and catching their dinner! After boarding back on night fell and we went to see and photograph the skyway Bridge lights! Members of the crew took pictures of your group on your camera with the bridge in the background. There was music and beverages for purchase. Totally recommend this!

A sunset cruise, better than I expected! Super impressed and very happy with this sunset cruise! It was not the one with a light show, but it was so enjoyable. We had a storm scare, but the Captain Dalton and Captain Justice were informative and polite during the wait. Also, you can tell Captain Dalton loves doing this, and loves to share his extensive knowledge of the area. We loved getting our feet wet on Shell Island, and we captured GREAT sunset pictures! Definitely would recommend!!
